templates.title: Prompt templates
templates.intro: Pick a template to start. Ones with [brackets] go to the message box so you can fill in the blank.
templates.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line · Fill the [blanks] before sending

waiting.label: Longest wait
waiting.prompt: Who is waiting longest right now, and with which doctor?

queue.label: Queue status
queue.prompt: Give me the queue status for each doctor: waiting, in consultation, delays.

schedule.label: Today's schedule
schedule.prompt: Show today's appointments by doctor, with any gaps or overlaps.

alerts.label: Alerts summary
alerts.prompt: Summarize today's alerts in 3 bullet points and tell me what to handle first.

slot.label: Find a free slot
slot.prompt: Find the next free [specialty] slot this week.

book.label: Book an appointment
book.prompt: Book [patient name] with [doctor or specialty] on [day] in the morning.

reschedule.label: Reschedule
reschedule.prompt: Reschedule appointment [AP-code] to the next free slot with the same doctor.

find.label: Find a patient
find.prompt: Find the patient [name, code or phone] and show their next appointment.

checkIn.label: Check in a patient
checkIn.prompt: Check in [patient name] for today's appointment.

optimize.label: Optimise today
optimize.prompt: Preview the optimiser for today: what would it change and how much waiting time would it save?

thisPatient.label: Summarize this patient
thisPatient.prompt: Summarize this patient: key problems, recent results, medications and open items.

thisPatientLab.label: Latest results
thisPatientLab.prompt: What did the latest lab report of this patient show? List abnormal values with their reference ranges.

summarize.label: Pre-visit summary
summarize.prompt: Summarize [patient name] before the visit: key problems, recent results and open items.

lastLab.label: Latest lab report
lastLab.prompt: What did [patient name]'s last lab report show? List abnormal values.

medications.label: Medications
medications.prompt: List the current medications of [patient name] found in notes and documents.

history.label: Visit history
history.prompt: Show the appointment history of [patient name] over the last 6 months.

schedule.label: My schedule today
schedule.prompt: What does my schedule look like today? Flag double bookings and long gaps.

tomorrow.label: Tomorrow
tomorrow.prompt: Who am I seeing tomorrow, and why? One line per patient.

note.label: Draft a clinical note
note.prompt: Draft a clinical note for [patient name]: [findings and plan].

patientSummary.label: Summary for the patient
patientSummary.prompt: Draft a plain-language summary for [patient name] that I can review and publish to the portal.

next.label: My next appointment
next.prompt: When is my next appointment, and with which doctor?

book.label: Book a visit
book.prompt: Book a [general medicine] check-up next week in the morning.

reschedule.label: Move an appointment
reschedule.prompt: Move my next appointment to another day next week.

explain.label: Explain my summary
explain.prompt: Explain my latest health summary in simple words.

documents.label: My documents
documents.prompt: What do my uploaded documents say, in simple words?

prepare.label: Prepare for a visit
prepare.prompt: How should I prepare for my next appointment? What should I bring?

hours.label: Opening hours
hours.prompt: What are the clinic's opening hours?

doctors.label: Doctors
doctors.prompt: Which doctors can I book, and what are their specialties?
